kubernetes.description: Scoped to manifests/. The previous '\.yaml$' matched every YAML in the repo, including docs/postiz-research/ and the 10k-line generated gotk-components.yaml.

flux.description: Tracks HelmRelease chart versions, which were previously invisible to Renovate.

packageRules.description: Nothing automerges. Every change lands via a PR that is reviewed, because Flux applies it to the cluster within 60s of merge.
Our own app; Flux image automation (clusters/my-cluster/image-automation.yaml) deploys new tags, not Renovate.
n8n and its task runners sidecar must run the same version, so one PR moves both.
LinuxServer tags are vX.Y.Z-lsN. Regex versioning ranks the -lsN rebuilds and skips the development-* and per-arch tags.

Flux notification API v1 needs Flux 2.10, which is blocked until k3s 1.35 lands (docs/runbooks/k3s-upgrade-1.35.md). Remove this rule in the Flux 2.10 PR; step 6 of that runbook moves flux-alerts.yaml to v1.
